# Welcome {.unnumbered}

Welcome to the BBSW 2026 workshop on agentic coding and harness engineering.

AI is progressing faster than ever, and a central question is emerging for
data professionals in pharma and biotech: how can we prepare ourselves to
create higher impact in our organizations and in healthcare?

This book accompanies a hands-on, beginner-friendly workshop on three
connected ideas: vibe coding, agentic workflows, and harness engineering.
Together, they form a self-validating loop that turns research intent into
regulatory-compliant statistical reality.

**This is a work-in-progress draft.**
